# Daily Briefing – Monday 13 October

Yesterday was a quieter day with no structured training and 6,929 steps — decent movement without a session. You burned 2,400 kcal, which nudged slightly above your 2,300 target, so overall balance was solid. Rest days like this have their place, especially with Chester 149 days out.

The recovery picture is mixed. Your HRV at 71ms sits notably below your 100–121ms baseline, and 6.2 hours sleep isn't quite enough to restore fully. Your resting HR of 56 bpm is reassuring, and stress at 37/100 is manageable — but the HRV dip is worth respecting. If a session is planned today, keep intensity moderate rather than pushing hard.

Prioritise sleep tonight — aim for 7.5–8 hours. That HRV won't climb back without it. Hit your 175g protein today too; it supports recovery even on lighter days.
